claimText: Controllers shall respond to a pilot's declaration of 'MINIMUM FUEL' by: 1. confirming the estimated delay he can expect to receive expressed in minutes if the pilot is en-route to, is joining, or is established in an airborne hold; 2. by expressing the remaining track mileage from touchdown if the aircraft is being vectored to an approach.
rationale: All attempts agree on the controller response, merging the split candidates from attempts 1 and 2 into a single comprehensive rule.
